settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Store-wide configuration. Changing these changes the storefront.

store.title: Store information
store.description: Shown in the header, the footer and in link previews.
store.name: Store name
store.nameHint: A brand name stays the same in every language, so this field isn't translated.

commerce.title: Commerce
commerce.currencyHint: One store-wide currency. Prices are stored as minor units of it.
commerce.shippingNote: Shipping zones and carrier rates arrive with the operations phase.

email.title: Email
email.description: Where transactional mail comes from and what triggers it.
email.lowStockAlerts: Email me when stock runs low
email.orderNotifications: Email me on every new order
email.notWired: No mail is sent yet. The provider is chosen in a later phase.

social.title: Social links
social.description: Shown in the footer. Leave a field empty to hide that channel.

branding.title: Branding
branding.noLogo: No logo yet; the store name is shown as text instead.
branding.uploadsUnavailable: Image uploads arrive in the next phase.

hours.title: Business hours
hours.description: Shown on the contact page and used for support expectations.

planned.title: This section is planned, not implemented
planned.body: The tab is here so you can see what the store will manage. You can't edit it yet, because there is nothing behind it.

reasons.needsCheckout: checkout and payments; these settings do nothing until orders exist
reasons.perUserLocale: a language saved on the account. Right now the interface language comes from the page address
reasons.themeIsPerVisitor: a store-wide look. Light and dark are each visitor's own choice at the moment

users.title: Team
users.subtitle: Administrators and what each of them can do.
users.emptyDescription: Every store needs at least one super administrator.
users.deactivatedNote: A deactivated administrator loses access immediately but keeps their name on everything they did.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Five built-in roles come with the store. They cannot be renamed or deleted.

users.inviteUnavailable: Inviting an administrator is not connected yet.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every change, who made it and when.
audit.emptyDescription: Changes made in the admin appear here.
audit.appendOnly: The audit log only ever grows. Nobody can edit or remove an entry.
